info.name: Optibus Operations Driver Absences Signing Times API
List driver signing times for a date in a region

params.name: regionName
params.description: - Name of the region for which to return signing times.

params.name: driverIds
params.description: - Comma-separated list of driver IDs to further narrow the result. Only drivers whose main or loaned region is the requested region on the date are eligible regardless of this filter.

params.name: page
params.description: - 1-indexed integer indicating which page of results to pull. Defaults to 1.

items.docs:
Returns matched expected/actual sign-on and sign-off times for drivers on a given date in a region.

Notes:
- The result is paginated by driver, 100 drivers per page. Check the `pagination` property in the response for total pages.
- A driver appears in the response if their main or loaned region is the requested region on the date, regardless of whether they have a calendar task. Drivers without any tasks or actual signings on the date appear with `signingTimes: []`.

params.name: from
params.description: The start of the date range to get the signing deviations from

params.name: to
params.description: The end of the date range to get the signing deviations from

params.name: regionUuid
params.description: The region to get the signing deviations from

params.name: driverIds
params.description: The driver IDs for which to get the signing deviations. if empty all drivers will be returned

items.docs:
Calculate the signing deviations for the drivers in the given date range and region. 'Signing deviations' refer to the difference between
the actual and expected sign-on and sign-off times for a driver. The expected times are calculated based on the driver's assigned work.

Deviation might be classified either early or late, calculated according to a defined threshold.
